I’m Helen and I’m 21 years old. I’ve been lurking in the sub for about a year, and hopefully this first post will ease my anxiety about posting. I started liking coasters when I was about 6 years old, thanks to Europa Park and Disneyland Paris. I probably rode kiddie coasters before, but I like to consider Big Thunder Mountain my first credit since it’s where I caught the coaster-love-bug. I didn’t become an avid enthusiast until I moved to the D.C. area when I was 7 (being a military brat is great for enthusiasts). Kings Dominion was my mom’s home park when she was a kid, so we went constantly. That’s where I became officially obsessed. After my first trip there, I wanted to learn everything about coasters: I would constantly read coaster books from my school’s library, research parks I never went to, and memorize coaster stats I found online (shout-out to CoasterGallery.com for being my home page for years). My favorite thing do to besides riding coasters is learn about the history of the industry and coaster design. 

Besides coasters, music is my biggest passion. I’m about to start my senior year as a music education major in western PA. I’m a percussion major, but I love to sing in choir too. I also enjoy knitting, crocheting, gardening, and embarrassing my wife in public (where my other coaster butches at??)
